narrative: A half sheet in the candlelight, two lines only, and no pen-stroke through either. The rest of the leaf is blank. At the edge of the board the cat is asleep on a thick folio. The writer's hand is at the margin. His face is not in the view. He has not touched the lines again. The blank below them is still blank. Yellow fog is on the pane, and the porch is not in the glass.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the sheet and did not mark it.

entities.name: the Chaucer
entities.context: Shown on draft in Left as it came
